exposure: uterine artery (Ut A) Doppler pulsatility index (PI)
outcome: reference centile charts for first-trimester aneuploidy screening parameters
correlation between screening parameters and CRL
cohort: The participants were 1204 Indian women with singleton pregnancies whose fetuses had a crown-rump length (CRL) between 40-84 mm.
finding: The study successfully constructed reference centile charts for first-trimester aneuploidy screening parameters (NT, PAPP-A, free b-hCG, Ut A Doppler PI) for the Indian population, demonstrating significant correlations with CRL.
cross-section timing: First trimester of pregnancy, based on fetal crown-rump length (CRL) of 40-84 mm
gest_age: Fetuses with crown-rump length (CRL) of 40-84 mm, corresponding to the first trimester
